name: Change an account's role
description: Admin only. `{"role": "admin"}` promotes an account, `{"role": "competitor"}` demotes one. The target must have signed in once, because the row is written by the GitHub callback, and the grant is on that row -- its GitHub id -- never on the handle, so a login GitHub later frees and hands to someone else does not carry it. THE CALLER CANNOT CHANGE THEIR OWN ROLE: every change is made by an admin who stays one, so the platform can never be left without one. A baseline is refused: nobody signs in to one. Demotion takes effect on the demoted admin's next request, because every admin route reads `role` off the live session, and it stops the runners on their keys at their next call. An account [vars] admin_github_ids lists is restored by its next sign-in; that is the deployment's way back in, not a bug in this route. WRITE, THEN DIAGNOSE: the UPDATE joins the caller's live admin session inside the statement and changes nothing otherwise, and `why` names the reason. The same role again is a 200 with `changed: false`. Each change tells the account (`account`) and every other admin (`admin`), after the decision and allowed to fail.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

tasks.name: Name this change
tasks.description: One id per change, the dedupe key of both notifications, so a retried write cannot say it twice.

input.query: UPDATE users t SET role = ($3)::user_role FROM live_sessions ls JOIN users me ON me.id = ls.user_id AND me.role = 'admin' WHERE ls.sid = ($2)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid AND t.id = ($4)::uuid AND t.id <> me.id AND t.role <> 'baseline' AND t.role <> ($3)::user_role

SELECT json_build_object('state', CASE WHEN t.id = ($1)::uuid THEN 'self' WHEN t.role = 'baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN t.role = ($3)::user_role THEN 'same' ELSE 'raced' END, 'role', t.role) AS body FROM users t WHERE t.id = ($2)::uuid

body.detail: No account has this id. An account exists once its owner has signed in.
Another admin changes your role, so the platform is never left without one.
A baseline is an uploaded opponent that nobody signs in to.

tasks.name: Tell the account
tasks.description: Read off the row, not the request: only a role the row now holds is announced.

input.query: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, category, kind, tone, subject, description, link, actor, data, dedupe_key) SELECT t.id, 'account', 'account', CASE WHEN t.role = 'admin' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'warn' END, CASE WHEN t.role = 'admin' THEN 'You are now an administrator' ELSE 'You are no longer an administrator' END, 'Changed by @' || left(me.handle, 64) || '.', CASE WHEN t.role = 'admin' THEN '/admin/seasons' ELSE '/me/account' END, me.handle, jsonb_build_object('role', t.role, 'by', me.handle), 'role:' || ($3)::uuid FROM users t JOIN users me ON me.id = ($2)::uuid WHERE t.id = ($1)::uuid AND t.role = ($4)::user_role AND notification_wanted(t.id, 'account') ON CONFLICT (user_id, dedupe_key) DO NOTHING

tasks.name: Tell the other admins
tasks.description: Every admin but the one who made the change and the account it was made to: a grant of the platform's highest role is never silent.

input.query: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, category, kind, tone, subject, description, link, actor, data, dedupe_key) SELECT a.id, 'admin', 'account', 'info', '@' || left(t.handle, 64) || CASE WHEN t.role = 'admin' THEN ' is now an administrator' ELSE ' is no longer an administrator' END, 'Changed by @' || left(me.handle, 64) || '.', '/admin/users', t.handle, jsonb_build_object('handle', t.handle, 'role', t.role, 'by', me.handle), 'role:' || ($3)::uuid FROM users t JOIN users me ON me.id = ($2)::uuid JOIN users a ON a.role = 'admin' AND a.id <> t.id AND a.id <> me.id WHERE t.id = ($1)::uuid AND t.role = ($4)::user_role AND notification_wanted(a.id, 'admin') ON CONFLICT (user_id, dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
